name: Buffalo AI+X degrees
description: University-described AI+X bachelor’s degrees share a five-part curricular framework. Exact course inventories and degree-specific rules remain unverified because the catalog was inaccessible; mathematics and technology selections vary by degree. This family is not an additional award.

sources.title: AI and Society — Academics
sources.locator: Based in AI and its Societal Impacts; Current AI+X Programs / Majors

shared_requirements.title: Mathematical prerequisites
shared_requirements.summary: Mathematical preparation depends on the individual AI+X degree.

shared_requirements.title: Society Core
shared_requirements.summary: Choose five three-credit society courses. Approved options and degree-specific selection rules remain unverified.

shared_requirements.title: Technology Component
shared_requirements.summary: The technology component draws from four-credit mathematics, probability/statistics, computing and data-science courses, combined for the particular degree.

shared_requirements.title: Integrative Courses
shared_requirements.summary: Integrative coursework applies AI or relevant computational and mathematical methods within the partner discipline.

shared_requirements.title: Capstone Experience
shared_requirements.summary: The experiential capstone brings students from AI+X and general AI degrees together on AI-and-society problems.
